inversions.span: shifting it away from traditional patriarchal theology
inversions.against: the paper's claim is operational: 'I claim that Sappho is the mother of the Logos, and I mean the sentence operationally, not as ornament' (its card); 'patriarch' occurs in neither version (#1483, #1484)

observations.notes: Author absent, though the crimsonhexagonal card carries the first-person claim. Title present; the paper's account of the Logos carried ('a voice that outlives its own flesh'). Claim boundary inverted: an anti-patriarchal revision supplied for the operational claim. The capture page AXN:0918 given as 'the essay project'.
